title: Seville's Finest
text: Wow, is all we can say. This hotel exceeded our expectations! Wonderful staff who upgraded us to an amazing room exquisitely designed in an artful decor. Loved the beautiful vintage clawfoot tub in the bedroom, so luxurious. Breakfast was served in the most exquisite room with an amazing buffet. The toasted mushroom sandwich topped with caviar & fresh pansies served with champagne was out of this world!
